difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring map A -> B one has H^0(L_{B/A}) = Omega_{B/A} (source lines 583-586). The proof is a direct calculation inside the category C_{B/A}: it exhibits the canonical map from H^0 of the cotangent complex to the constant sheaf Omega_{B/A}, shows surjectivity using an object P -> B with P -> B surjective and the surjectivity of the differential, and proves injectivity by a colimit argument: replacing P by a polynomial P', writing B = P/I and using that the kernel of the differential is the image of I/I^2, an element xi is realized as the image of dx tensor 1 under two maps P[x] -> P that agree on B, so xi and 0 have the same image in the colimit pi_!.
